description.p: Call a solver with one output to get a solution structure. The structure stores accepted internal steps; array outputs such as [t, y] use requested or refined output points. Use deval to evaluate the solution structure at additional times.

tr.td: Evaluation points must stay inside the solution interval.
Derivative output follows the same column layout as y.
Builds a new solution structure on the extended interval.

description.p: Use odextend to continue an integration from the final state while preserving solution metadata and events.

example_item.example_item_description: Evaluate a solution at requested points.
